name: @red-cup-engineering/verdaccio-services-section
description: Runs the ordinary private npm registry for 561 Group packages using Verdaccio.

scripts.serve: npm run configure-client && node scripts/harden-htpasswd-permissions.mjs && verdaccio --config content/config/config.yaml
scripts.serve:cold-red-gate: npm run configure-client:cold-red-gate && node scripts/harden-htpasswd-permissions.mjs && verdaccio --config content/config/cold-red-gate.yaml
scripts.check: node --check scripts/configure-npm-scope-routing.mjs && node --check scripts/ping-verdaccio.mjs && node --check scripts/harden-htpasswd-permissions.mjs
